description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Instant Cast 1], [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000], [Spellblade Assault Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)] and [Prepare to Charge] to the user

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Spellblade Assault Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Prepare to Charge
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using two Fire/Ice/Lightning Spellblade abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning damage
